subject: Disputed renewal true-up: duplicate usage billing after migration
messages:
From: Marco Diaz <marco.diaz@acadiahealth.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@acadiahealth.com
Date: 2026-05-01T09:14:00Z
Subject: Discrepancy on renewal true-up invoice

Olga,

We received the renewal true-up invoice this morning (INV-ACD-2026-04) and are seeing ~18k tokens billed twice for the migration window (Apr 22-24). Our internal logs show a single migration request; looks like Redwood's backend emitted duplicate requests during the model swap. Can you confirm whether this is a billing-side double-count?

We also need confirmation on VAT treatment: Acadia is registered in Germany and will supply a valid VAT certificate, but the invoice is currently charged with VAT. Please advise next steps so procurement can approve payment.

I attached our activity export for the dates in question.

Thanks,
Marco
Procurement Lead, Acadia Health
[attachment: acct_activity.csv (CSV, 38KB)]

From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: Marco Diaz <marco.diaz@acadiahealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-01T11:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on renewal true-up invoice

Hi Marco — thank you for flagging this and for the export. I've pulled the invoice and the serving logs; initial look suggests a short-lived retry loop during the model handoff that generated duplicate token accounting entries.

Next steps I propose:
- I'll open a billing review ticket and attach the serving logs for Apr 22-24.
- Karthik, can you pause collection for INV-ACD-2026-04 until we reconcile?
- Marco, please send over the VAT certificate when convenient — procurement@acadiahealth has my contact. We'll aim to re-issue the invoice without VAT if the certificate validates EU intra-company supply.

I'll follow up with the internal ticket ID and an ETA by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
[internal note: flagged for finance]

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-02T08:37:00Z
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on renewal true-up invoice

Looping finance — I put a temporary hold on the invoice in our billing system (HOLD-BILL-4917). Finance, please do not push to collections while we validate.

I ran a compare between our usage export and the attached account file; preliminary diff attached (redwood-usage-compare-202604.csv). There's a clear duplicated event cluster from 2026-04-22T03:42:xx through 2026-04-22T03:47:xx for model: redwood-v1-small. Looks like a retry bubbled up to the metering layer.

Finance/CS action items:
- Neha: confirm whether VAT is currently being applied on the invoice and hold any auto-tax adjustments until Marco provides certificate.
- Marissa: SOS on whether CS should reach out to engineering to confirm root cause and any customer-facing note.

I'll keep the billing hold until reconciliation complete (target: 3 business days).

Thanks,
Karthik
Billing Ops

From: Marco Diaz <marco.diaz@acadiahealth.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@acadiahealth.com
Date: 2026-05-04T14:21:00Z
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on renewal true-up invoice

Thanks, Olga and team. VAT certificate attached — that's our EU registration and should qualify Acadia for reverse charge. Please confirm you received it and whether you need a signed PO reference.

Also, if you can provide a short breakdown (token counts per day + indicated duplicates) that will help us clear this with our internal auditors. We're trying to avoid delaying the renewal if possible.

Best,
Marco
[attachment: vat_certificate_acadia.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: Marco Diaz <marco.diaz@acadiahealth.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-06T16:33:00Z
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on renewal true-up invoice — resolution plan and next steps

Marco — received the VAT cert, thanks. Quick update and plan: 

1) Root cause and reproducible evidence
- Engineering confirmed a retry loop during the model swap at 2026-04-22T03:42–03:48 UTC which caused duplicate metering lines. They've exported the affected request IDs and token deltas.

2) Billing remediation
- We will void INV-ACD-2026-04 and issue corrected invoice INV-ACD-2026-04R with duplicate token lines removed; target issuance: 2026-05-08. The corrected invoice will be net of VAT (reverse charge) contingent on the supplied certificate.
- Temporary hold (HOLD-BILL-4917) remains until the corrected invoice is sent.

3) Collection & PO
- If you can share PO number, we'll add it to the reissued invoice to help procurement routing. Otherwise, we'll include a HubSpot reference and your internal contact details.

4) Credits and goodwill
- Because this caused a renewal friction, Redwood will apply a one-time credit of €250 to the account, reflected on the reissued invoice.

Attachments: redwood-usage-compare-202604.csv (internal compare)

Action items for this thread: 
- Marco: send PO number (if available) — procurement@acadiahealth.com
- Neha: re-run VAT lookup and confirm net of VAT before finalizing invoice.
- Marissa/CS: prepare a one-paragraph explanation for audit (we will include the engineering log excerpt).

I'll follow up once INV-ACD-2026-04R is uploaded to the portal. Thank you for the quick turnaround.

Regards,
Olga Petrov
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
[attachment: redwood-usage-compare-202604.csv (CSV, 12KB)]
